newsitem.title: USA: Honda 1996 sales set all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Honda 1996 sales set all-time high.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd on Friday said its Honda division in 1996 had the best year in its history, selling between 730,000 and 740,000 vehicles in the United States.

American Honda Executive Vice President Tom Elliott said 1996 sales rise about nine percent from 1995. Including sales from Honda's upscale Acura Division, Elliott said Honda sold about 854,000 vehicles in the United States in 1996. Final sales figures are scheduled to be released on Monday.
Elliott said Honda sold 2.1 million vehicles worldwide in 1996, the first time Honda has sold more than 2 million vehicles in one year.
